_: Film d'accueil « 24 heures avec Doji ». Kévin a validé le concept le 29/10/2026 à 16 h 23 (« go on attaque ») ; « la voix off ne doit pas trop faire IA ».

lines.text: Six fifty-nine. The world is still asleep. Doji is already on watch.
Seven a.m. Your terminal builds itself, block by block. Exactly the way you want it.
Eight thirty. Forty markets, screened for you. A clear bias, before your first coffee.
Two thirty p.m. The US inflation number drops. And you already know how the market reacted, every single time.
Three p.m. Before you enter, thirty seconds. Doji checks the calendar, the levels, your risk. Green light? The decision is still yours.
Five p.m. Hundreds of rules, tested. We keep the ones that hold. We throw out the rest.
Ten p.m. Verdict time. Every idea, winner or loser, out in the open.
Three a.m. Crypto never stops. Neither does Doji. X-Ray on the order books, live.
Elsewhere, you drown in numbers. Here, every one of them has a reason to be there. To learn, to understand, to decide.
MACROARSENAL. Every hour of your trading, mastered.
